name: HI Mobility Berhad
overview: HI Mobility 今年完成收购 Acacia Motor Services 和 Handal BCM，并将业务多元化至商用车制造、组装、分销、销售及维修领域；同时与 Global Sustainable Transport Innovation and Knowledge Centre 签署谅解备忘录，探索交通科技领域的潜在合作。
overview_en: HI Mobility completed the acquisitions of Acacia Motor Services and Handal BCM this year and diversified into the manufacturing, assembly, distribution, selling, maintenance and repair of commercial motor vehicles; it also signed a memorandum of understanding with Global Sustainable Transport Innovation and Knowledge Centre to explore potential collaboration in the transportation technology sector.

segments.name: 定期巴士服务
segments.note: 今年与 Global Sustainable Transport Innovation and Knowledge Centre 签署谅解备忘录，探索交通科技领域的潜在合作。
segments.note_en: This year, it signed a memorandum of understanding with Global Sustainable Transport Innovation and Knowledge Centre to explore potential collaboration in the transportation technology sector.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 全资子公司 Handal Indah Sdn. Bhd. 与 Global Sustainable Transport Innovation and Knowledge Centre 签署谅解备忘录，探索交通科技领域的潜在合作。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Handal Indah Sdn. Bhd. entered into a memorandum of understanding with Global Sustainable Transport Innovation and Knowledge Centre to explore potential collaboration in the transportation technology sector.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 收购 Acacia Motor Services 和 Handal BCM 及业务多元化交易于 2026 年 4 月 8 日完成，代价通过发行及配发代价股份全数支付。
actions.text_en: The acquisitions of Acacia Motor Services and Handal BCM and the diversification were completed on 8 April 2026, with the purchase consideration fully settled via the issuance and allotment of consideration shares.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 收购协议的所有先决条件已于 2026 年 4 月 1 日满足或获豁免。
actions.text_en: All conditions precedent under the share sale agreements were satisfied or waived on 1 April 2026.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 并将业务多元化至商用车制造、组装、分销、销售及维修领域；Bursa Securities 于 2026 年 1 月 29 日批准发行 34,385,068 股新股。
actions.text_en: Proposed acquisitions of Acacia Motor Services and Handal BCM and diversification into the manufacturing, assembly, distribution, selling, maintenance and repair of commercial motor vehicles;

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 收购 Acacia Motor Services 和 Handal BCM 及业务多元化交易完成，公司业务新增商用车制造、组装、分销、销售、维护及维修。
model_changes.text_en: The acquisitions of Acacia Motor Services and Handal BCM and the diversification were completed, adding the manufacturing, assembly, distribution, selling, maintenance and repair of commercial motor vehicles to the company's business.
